The '''Military Police''' was the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] arm of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Military/Legends|Military]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It could be authorized by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to take over an investigation if [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and/or other military personnel were involved.
